text: Karooooo Ltd's ordinary shares are listed on the Nasdaq and the JSE, and its founder and chief executive officer Zak Calisto, its controlling shareholder, controls a majority of the combined voting power of its outstanding shares.
short: Karooooo is Nasdaq/JSE-listed; founder and CEO Zak Calisto controls a majority of the votes.

source.name: Karooooo Ltd Form 20-F for fiscal year ended February 28, 2026 (SEC EDGAR) - Risk factors and share information
source.quote: Our controlling shareholder and chief executive officer, Zak Calisto, controls a majority of the combined voting power of our outstanding ordinary shares
